critical_code_review_comments: engines.py commission_base_excl_tax() docstring still says 'coupon added back so partner earns on full pre-coupon amount' — but new finalize() applies coupon via DISCOUNT_KEYS BEFORE partner_share split, so partner now absorbs the coupon too. Behaviour matches new product spec (coupon on service side pre-commission); update the stale docstring to avoid confusing future readers.

gst_invoice_service.build_block() recomputes `taxable = total - gst - partner_share` rather than reading pricing.taxable/tax_base directly; this works but creates a parallel calc path. Prefer reading pr['taxable'] when present for a single source of truth.

invoice_routes._sample_gst passes gst_pct=18 default but settings.gst_pct is admin-configurable; preview_sample subtotal/tax calc also hardcodes different sample numbers (1499/150) than the gst_invoice sample (259+99+99). Fine for a demo but inconsistent.
